        Federal & EU calls

        Calls from Grants.gov (U.S. federal agencies) and the EU Funding & Tenders portal. U.S. federal calls are mostly for U.S. institutions, and EU calls mostly for applicants based in the EU or associated countries, so check eligibility on each call.

          About this page

          Saving and downloading

          There are no accounts. Save keeps a listing in this browser on this device, and your research keywords are kept the same way. Nothing is sent to UNC.

          Clearing your browser data removes them, so open Saved to download your list (CSV for Excel, or a calendar file) or email it to yourself.

          How listings are kept current

          UNC Global Affairs curates these listings from sponsors' official pages and refreshes this page regularly. Reload the page to see the latest version.

          Deadlines and rules change, so always confirm the details on the sponsor's official call before you apply.

          Suggest an opportunity

          Know a call that belongs here, or spotted an out-of-date listing? Email UNC Global Affairs.

          Looking for something specific? Ask one of our funding agents from the button at the top of the page.
